existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `SpecimenDefinition` has material local breaks: R6 requires `status`, changes `identifier` from 0..1 to 0..*, and changes additive references from `Substance` to `SubstanceDefinition`. R6 also adds metadata and workflow qualifiers that are lossy when downgraded to R4.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration must fix required data, serialization shape, and reference targets. R4-to-R6 transforms should assign `status`, wrap `identifier` in an array when present, and map additive references. R6-to-R4 transforms need extension or sidecar policies for new metadata, subject, single-use, and testing-destination content.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for structural changes because they are directly visible in the R4 and R6 StructureDefinition differentials and snapshots. Confidence is medium for terminology impact because ValueSet compose definitions were compared without live SNOMED CT expansions or official change rationale.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
SpecimenDefinition keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 3 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 0 potential hard break(s), 3 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 0 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 0, which creates weak stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 38/100, producing migration shape `moderate-targeted-remodel`, major migration `Partial`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: Container additive Reference target changed from Substance to SubstanceDefinition
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 `Reference(Substance)` additive values no longer satisfy the R6 target profile; R6 `Reference(SubstanceDefinition)` values are also not native R4 references.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: identifier changed from singleton to repeating
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: a populated R4 JSON `identifier` object must be wrapped as an R6 array; R6 instances with multiple identifiers cannot be represented natively in R4 without choosing or extending.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 adds mandatory modifier status to SpecimenDefinition
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 instances without `status` fail R6 base validation until a status such as `unknown`, `draft`, or `active` is supplied; R6 status also has no native R4 slot.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 adds optional canonical and publication metadata not native to R4
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: R6 metadata cannot be represented natively in R4, but no old R4 instance becomes invalid because these fields are optional.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
